title: U2 open the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame ceremony with a surprise performance
summary: The Irish band played a song from their new album the day after its release.
body:
U2 made a surprise appearance at the start of the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony in Los Angeles on Saturday 14 November.

The band, who were not among this year's inductees, played two songs. They opened with "Silencio", a single from their new album Carnaval de Luz, which came out the day before, and closed with their 1984 hit "Pride (In the Name of Love)".

A night of guest stars

The ceremony at the Peacock Theater honoured Phil Collins, Oasis, Iron Maiden, Wu-Tang Clan, Sade and others. It will be shown on ABC on 8 December and stream on Disney+ the following day.

Sources: Billboard, Consequence.
